retained_limits: Table/source/certification exactness and physical initial/one-step closure are explicit theorem premises, not empirical runtime verification.
General R1 occupancy and safety allow time-varying numerical P with fixed support R; the matrix-power endpoint requires a fixed numerical Model.
Runtime recomputes a recursive checker; no memoized support-action table or practical-complexity guarantee.
No logical independence, scientific novelty, counted-ledger or strong scientific-closure promotion is inferred.
